summary: Helena NF summit in Powell County; the only dated record is a 1939 plan to move the Treasure Mountain lookout here, which apparently never happened. No tower or site status is documented.

visit.trail_note: An event listing describes a loop hike from the Monarch Trailhead to Bison Mountain. No source describes the summit itself.

events.note: Newspaper report of a plan to move the Treasure Mountain lookout to Bison Mountain; the Treasure Mountain page adds that the move apparently did not happen

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Bison Mountain page describes only a plan under consideration in 1939. The Treasure Mountain page quotes a 1939 newspaper saying the lookout would be moved, then adds that it apparently was not. The story reports the plan and the note that it apparently did not happen.

notes_for_editor: Record fields (Powell County, Helena NF, status unknown) match the sources; no correction proposed. The only dated item is the 1939 plan, so the events list holds no build, staffing or fire entries. The summit is identified by name, by the Treasure entry's 'summit above the old Monarch mine', and by the event listing's Monarch Trailhead and Elliston; no source gives coordinates that confirm it. Neither the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Montana list nor firelookout.com's Montana index has a Bison Mountain entry. Access today rests on one event listing that describes a hike and mentions no structure. Check with the Helena National Forest before any visit.
